name: Hot Potato
review:
Hot Potato is a 7x7 cluster-pays slot with exploding wilds, avalanches and a multiplier grid. In the bonus, free spins come with retriggers and sticky multiplier grids.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 10,000x cap and a 96.16% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
